additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375731-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001144] OCPP Offline CRM:00642001436
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
hope you are doing great.
I would like to provide an update: upon reviewing the charger's logs, we have encountered the "ERR_ROUTER_LOGIN_FAILED" issue.
The charger was offline due to an ERR_ROUTER_LOGIN_FAILED issue. The resolution for this is to reboot the charger, as the problem occurs when the PLC is unable to connect with the router.
We have verified the router settings via SSH access, and the router configuration is perfectly fine.
Kindly confirm the same from your end.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
